title: Bernband inspired tech demo built in a custom Game Maker Studio
author: Somnati
selftext: slowly expanding the capabilities of my 3d workflow and currently have a small but nice little area to explore.

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body: Looking great, keep at it. I'm on a simliar project myself so I appreciate this! I think the rain effect/puddles/splashes is already looking real good. Never heard of Bernband btw, was it some viral thing? It looks like a cool game concept.

replies.author: Somnati
replies.body:
Yeah the rain does look great...

Bernband was an old pixilated walking Sim through a mysterious alien brutalist city... I'm trying to match it's vibe while learning 3d level design and such. 

I hope to have pathtracing in in a couple weeks along with bigger levels and improved workflow
